documentation.memberTotalsBasis: councillors.json per-member career totals are aggregate-basis (743,677 vote rows, 2006 onward, five terms). Stored name-by-name rows number 157,292 and cover 2018 onward only; 30 members have zero stored rows. Published participation is aggregate-basis.
documentation.interestCounters: The 'interest' counter in councillors.json and stats.json interestRows count recorded votes flagged 'Absent (Interest Declared)' (119 in the member layer). They are not counts of the Registry of Declared Interest; the served register (declared-interests.json) holds 1,249 councillor-matched declarations drawn from 1,594 collected declarations (345 declarations by non-councillor declarants are not served).
documentation.termBuckets: The 'terms' values in councillors.json are election-cycle bucket labels (e.g. '2018-2022'), not exact service start/end dates; members who joined or left mid-term share the bucket label.
documentation.mayorFlag: The 'mayor' flag in councillors.json marks the CURRENT mayor only (Olivia Chow). Former mayors (Tory, Miller, Ford) carry mayor:false.
documentation.hasVote: An index brief's hasVote flag means a recorded vote tally exists for the item. Of 3,171 hasVote briefs, 2,962 carry name-by-name vote rows and 209 carry tallies only (261 tally-only motions), for which no name-by-name list exists.
documentation.lastSeen: lastSeen semantics are UNSETTLED and the field is not displayed anywhere on the site. Three candidate definitions were tested against the stored member rows on 2026-10-23 (max date over all stored rows: 37/64 members with rows match; max date in the primary member file: 61/64; last Council-stage vote: 23/64). None fits all members, so no values were changed.
documentation.memberBriefCoverage: The member vote layer holds 157,292 rows; the decision-brief layer holds 155,795. The member layer is a per-motion superset of the brief layer (no motion key has more brief rows than member rows). The 1,497-row gap across 272 motion keys is structural, in three classes verified 2026-10-23: (1) 859 rows on 243 motions the brief layer carries as tally-only (the brief shows the count; the member layer holds the name rows for the same motions); (2) 512 rows on 24 motion keys the member layer recorded more than once under an identical key (e.g. 2018.EY29.51 'Reconsider Item', recorded twice; 2020.BU14.2 budget motions repeated); (3) 126 rows on 5 keys where a decision carries several motions of the same type at the same stage (e.g. repeated 'Amend Item' motions on 2023.PH5.3, 2019.BU4.4, 2022.EX30.2, 2019.BL2.1) and the member layer's recordings of those repeated motions exceed the brief layer's. No Council-stage decision is missing a brief because of this gap. Interest-declared flags: 119 in the member layer, 116 on brief-layer motions — the extra flags ride on the tally-only and duplicated motions above, so the two surfaces count different layers and are labelled accordingly.
documentation.testRecordExclusion: The City test record 2020.CC2.1 ('testing iPad', 2020-11-30, no action) is excluded from the derived index-2020, search-2020 and text-2020 layers. The decisions total (33,796) still counts it, as it counts all decisions in the source database; the per-decision detail file is retained.
